ideas.pitch: A real-time audio surveillance edge-node network that processes urban or border noise via lightweight neural networks to instantly classify explosive signatures and stream precise GIS coordinates to field personnel.
ideas.title: Acoustic Threat Triangulation Grid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the Blueprint for Peace theme on national security and defense technologies, replicating the proven architecture of hardware-integrated audio detection that wins security hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent pipeline that scrapes regional disaster-zone supply marketplaces and logistics feeds to optimize civilian relief allocation and detect fraudulent aid distribution in real-time.
ideas.title: Multi-Agent Humanitarian Logistics Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages complex multi-agent architectures on fresh scraped data, a pattern demonstrated by winning teams tackling logistical and trafficking challenges.

ideas.pitch: A public-accountability mapping platform where every reconstruction contract and fund request carries a cryptographic seal, allowing citizens to independently verify fund allocation and resource delivery.
ideas.title: Cryptographic Post-War Infrastructure Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines public transparency with verifiable cryptographic proof, matching the exact winning formula of trust-centric public works hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computing video processing pipeline designed to ingest public CCTV streams, run local face-recognition against a dynamic watchlist, and securely dispatch encrypted alert emails to security officials.
ideas.title: CCTV Wanted Criminal Biometric Edge Screener
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles critical civilian protection infrastructure with a fully demonstrable end-to-end pipeline that judges in defense and public safety tracks can immediately test live.

ideas.pitch: A predictive modeling tool using Poisson Generalized Additive Models to forecast regional security incidents and civil unrest spikes, providing calibrated prediction intervals to defense strategists.
ideas.title: AI Conflict Incident Forecasting Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements rigorous quantitative forecasting and statistical validation, giving technical judges hard mathematical models rather than hand-wavy AI wrappers.
